subtitle: Lesson 5 · From git push to a Running Pod

code:
- run: npm test
- name: Build image
  run: docker build -t acrdriftwoodprod.azurecr.io/storefront:${{ github.sha }} .
- name: Scan image with Trivy
  uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@0.28.0
  with:
    image-ref: acrdriftwoodprod.azurecr.io/storefront:${{ github.sha }}
    severity: CRITICAL
    exit-code: "1"
caption: Test, build, and scan -- every image SHA-tagged, never latest.
OIDC login, no stored secret -- then helm upgrade --install applies values-prod.yaml exactly as written.
